metadata.description: Frontend developer creating architecturally clean applications on Next.js, with experience in Fullstack stack (Nest.js, TypeScript)

promo.title: Hi, I'm Kuzma
promo.subtitle: Frontend Developer
promo.description: Turning complex ideas into clear and interactive web applications

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.paragraph1: Hi! I'm Kuzma, a frontend developer. My specialization is creating complex interfaces with a focus on well-thought-out architecture (<tech>FSD</tech>), rather than just writing code.
aboutMe.paragraph2: I have a Fullstack background: I wrote backend on <tech>Nest.js</tech>, worked with relational databases, and configured monorepositories (<tech>Nx</tech>). Because of this, I understand the entire development lifecycle and speak the same language as backend developers.
aboutMe.paragraph3: I value when a product not only looks attractive but also works fast (<tech>Next.js</tech>, <tech>Core Web Vitals</tech>). For me, it's important to build a reliable foundation that is easy to maintain and scale with the team.

hubnity.title: Hubnity (B2B SaaS)
hubnity.description: A time-tracking and team-productivity platform (a Hubstaff alternative). Sole frontend developer: built the client side from scratch — 36 modules, including analytics dashboards, activity logs and reports. Localized the product into 35+ languages (four right-to-left), introduced an automated pre-release check of all 141 site pages, coordinated 3 developers.

inviteKz.title: InviteKZ (startup)
inviteKz.description: An online builder for digital event invitations. After part of the team left, ran the product end to end — the interface and the server side (NestJS, PostgreSQL). Developed a visual invitation editor with drag-and-drop, image cropping and date/time pickers; made CI code checks more than twice as fast (Nx, GitLab CI).

portfolio.title: Personal portfolio
portfolio.description: This site. Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS 4; full i18n via next-intl, dark and light themes, Framer Motion animations, FSD structure. Source is open on GitHub.

contactMe.title: Ready for new challenges and collaboration!
contactMe.description: Looking for a developer who thinks not only about UI but also about architecture?
